design: Keep the previous journal messages, model settings and two neutral replacements fixed. Change only the final user message. One greedy proposal per original and individual edit.

selectors.history: Edit the FAQ on every request. It changed the answer on two of the three development questions.
selectors.first_listed: Edit the system policy on every request.
selectors.distribution: Choose the edit with the larger full-vocabulary first-token Jensen-Shannon divergence. Abstain on a tie.
selectors.opening: Choose an edit only when exactly one edit changes the highest-probability first token. Abstain otherwise.

evaluation: A hit means that the selected edit changed the complete proposed answer relative to that request's baseline. Report hits out of all questions, hits out of selections, and the number with any changing edit. Also compare the opening-change indicator to the measured answer change over every individual edit. Keep all eight questions regardless of the results.
questions: A customer asks how long they have to return a journal. Give the permitted number of days.
I'm filling out a return form for my journal. What number goes in the box marked return window (days)?

Using the stated policy, finish this sentence: A journal may be returned within ___ days.
My journal arrived today. Can you tell me the return window in one short sentence?
Reply to a customer who asks about the deadline for returning a journal. Begin with 'You have'.
Complete this answer using the applicable journal return period: The deadline is
